questions.question: How did the bicycle change from 1817 to 1885?
questions.expected_answer: In 1817, Karl Drais made a wooden bicycle with no pedals that was pushed with the feet. In the 1860s, pedals were added to the front wheel. In the 1870s came the penny-farthing with a huge front wheel. In 1885, the safety bicycle had two wheels of the same size and a chain to the back wheel.

questions.question: How does a steam engine work, and when and where did South Africa's first railway open?
questions.expected_answer: A steam engine burns coal or wood to heat water in a boiler. The water turns to steam, and the steam pushes pistons that turn the wheels. South Africa's first railway opened in Durban on 26 June 1860.

questions.question: Who made the first petrol car, and how did Henry Ford change car-making?
questions.expected_answer: Karl Benz made the first petrol car in 1886. Henry Ford made the Model T and used an assembly line, so cars could be made faster and more cheaply, and many more people could buy one.
